text: 10 OVERDOSAGE 10.1 Manifestations Manifestations of TRISENOX (arsenic trioxide) overdosage include convulsions, muscle weakness, and confusion. 10.2 Management If symptoms of TRISENOX (arsenic trioxide) overdosage develop, the injection should be immediately discontinued and chelation therapy should be considered. A conventional protocol for acute arsenic intoxication includes dimercaprol administered at a dose of 3 mg/kg intramuscularly every 4 hours until immediate life-threatening toxicity has subsided. Thereafter, penicillamine at a dose of 250 mg orally, up to a maximum frequency of four times per day (≤ 1 g per day), may be given.
